children: At least 12 people were injured in a shooting in Tallahassee, Florida, near Florida A&M University's Bragg Memorial Stadium late on Saturday night, the local police department and the university said.
Police said 11 of the 12 injured sustained gunshot wounds, adding that 6 of the injured were adults and 6 were juveniles.
"At this time, at least three of the shooting victims have sustained serious injuries, while nine others are reported to be in stable condition," the Tallahassee Police Department said.
